call_action_host.description: Partner hostname domain for click-to-call, without the https:// prefix. Example: portal.xxx.com

regex.hostname_only-error: Hostname only, without protocol (no https://) and no trailing slash

call_action_path.description: Path of the programmable flow used for click-to-call, starting with /. Example: /_o/api/v2/flows/<id>/execute

tenant_token.description: Bearer token used to call the partner click-to-call endpoint. Stored encrypted and injected into the Authorization header by the platform.

api_shared_secret.description: To obtain the short-lived JWT for the WebSocket connection. Stored encrypted.
